prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_milestones_info: Adds explicit progress status indicators and milestone status details during the rendering waiting step.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Preparing your desktop pet... System environment and pet assets are being verified."}}
1: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout focusing on desktop pet visibility and initial activation steps.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look for your pet on your desktop screen. Click on it anytime to open pet options or hide/show controls."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] new_screen_adoption_preview_confirmation: Inserts a new confirmation screen prior to certificate issue to review custom pet features.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_adoption_preview": {"headline": "Confirm Pet Appearance", "body": "Review your pet's custom features and traits before finalizing adoption.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] choose_path_interactive_preview_flow: Rebuilds choose_path with interactive path cards allowing users to preview starter options before selecting.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "body": "Explore different starter paths below to find the best match for your workflow and desktop style."}}
4: [finish, hint] home_intro_control_dock_hint: Displays explicit instructions on how to summon, control, and interact with the pet post-setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Alt+P or right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, hide, or send messages."}}
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_account_sync_notification: Adds a notification informing users that signing in restores existing account pets and progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in syncs your account profile and restores any existing pets automatically.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
6: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_compact_grid_redesign: Redesigns upload_photos into a split layout to provide clear photo quality standards.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Upload 1-3 well-lit photos of your pet. Ensure clear lighting for best recognition."}}
7: [home, layout] waiting_screen_two_column_layout: Reorganizes the waiting screen into a two-column view separating render status from desktop tips.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet files are being configured. We're finalizing desktop integration."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_spotlight_layout: Updates choose_path screen to a spotlight layout to highlight key companion features.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Select Your Journey", "body": "Pick your companion's persona to get started instantly."}}
9: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_first_interaction_flow: Rebuilds home_intro as a checklist flow verifying desktop controls before completing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Quick Desktop Pet Check", "body": "Complete these quick steps to ensure your pet is fully visible and responsive on your screen."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds progress status and time estimate during the real waiting step without violating rules.
Redesigns home_intro layout while preserving its role in onboarding.
Adds a valid confirmation preview screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps.
Redesigns choose_path into card previews while preserving the choice between starter paths.
Adds helpful control dock interaction instructions on home_intro.
Adds account sync notification to sign in screen without requesting new personal data.
Redesigns upload_photos layout while preserving photo upload functionality.
Reorganizes waiting screen into a two-column view while keeping its core job.
Loses the job of choose_path screen by replacing the choice between adopting and making your own with persona selection.
Rebuilds home_intro as a checklist interaction flow within allowed onboarding changes.
